# Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)

> > FEE is a leading educational organization promoting free-market economics, individual liberty, and limited government through articles, analysis, and programs.

Founded by Leonard E. Read, the Foundation for Economic Education publishes commentary on economic policy, regulation, trade, and freedom philosophy. The site features analysis of contemporary policy debates involving figures like Donald Trump and Javier Milei, alongside historical case studies and explorations of economic thinkers like Friedrich Hayek.

## Key Topics

- Free-market economics
- Deregulation
- Economic freedom
- Tariffs and trade policy
- Housing policy
- Spontaneous order
- Brussels Effect and EU regulation
- Leonard E. Read and FEE history
- Liberty vs. security debates
- Automation and employment
- Antitrust policy
- Self-governance and stateless societies
- Inflation hedging strategies
- Entrepreneurship education

## Trade Policy and Economic Regulation

- [Trump's Unrealistic Demand that Walmart 'Eat the Tariffs'](https://fee.org/articles/trumps-unrealistic-demand-that-walmart-eat-the-tariffs): Analysis of Trump's demand that Walmart absorb tariff costs via margins
- [Antitrust and Tariffs Are on a Collision Course](https://fee.org/articles/antitrust-and-tariffs-are-on-a-collision-course): How Trump tariffs create antitrust risks for vertical merger strategies
- [The Muscle of Brussels](https://fee.org/articles/the-muscle-of-brussels): EU's regulatory superpower and the Brussels Effect on global tech standards
- [International Tech's Tug of War](https://fee.org/articles/international-techs-tug-of-war): China's Huawei and the 5G/AI competition with free market alternatives
- [Trump's America and Milei's Argentina](https://fee.org/articles/trumps-america-and-mileis-argentina): Comparing Trump and Milei's fiscal policy and deregulation approaches

## FEE History and Freedom Philosophy

- [Leonard E. Read, Crusader](https://fee.org/articles/leonard-e-read-crusader): Biography of FEE founder Leonard E. Read and the freedom philosophy movement
- [Phillis Wheatley and Black Heroes of the Revolution](https://fee.org/articles/phillis-wheatley-and-black-heroes-of-the-revolution): Phillis Wheatley and African American heroes of the American Revolution
- [The Couto Mixto](https://fee.org/articles/the-couto-mixto): Historical case study of Couto Mixto's stateless society and self-governance

## Government Regulation and Individual Liberty

- [Governments Assault on Freedom to Work](https://fee.org/articles/governments-assault-on-freedom-to-work): DiLorenzo on employment regulation, minimum wage, and occupational licensing
- [Yes, You Can Protect Liberty and Security at the Same Time](https://fee.org/articles/yes-you-can-protect-liberty-and-security-at-the-same-time): Ron Paul on liberty-security tradeoff, TSA criticism, and private security
- [The Bureaucrat Becomes a Spectator](https://fee.org/articles/the-bureaucrat-becomes-a-spectator): AI automation's impact on bureaucracy reform and labor displacement
- [Water Pressure](https://fee.org/articles/water-pressure): Trump administration's deregulation of showerhead water pressure standards

## Housing and Urban Policy

- [New York's New Leadership Offers Champagne Socialism](https://fee.org/articles/new-yorks-new-leadership-offers-champagne-socialism): NYC Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani's democratic socialist housing policies
- [This Tenant 'Right to Repair' Law Will Create More Problems Than It Fixes](https://fee.org/articles/this-tenant-right-to-repair-law-will-create-more-problems-than-it-fixes): Critique of Duluth's tenant right-to-repair law and moral hazard concerns

## Economic Education and Personal Finance

- [4 Ways Young People Can Hedge against Inflation](https://fee.org/articles/4-ways-young-people-can-hedge-against-inflation): Personal finance strategies for young adults to protect wealth from inflation
- [#45 – "Robots and Computerization Cause Unemployment"](https://fee.org/articles/45-robots-and-computerization-cause-unemployment): Debunking automation unemployment fears from free market perspective
- [Announcing the 2025 Enterprising Founder Award Winners!](https://fee.org/articles/announcing-the-2025-enterprising-founder-award-winners): 2025 Enterprising Founder Award winners in education entrepreneurship

## Optional

- [Ticket to Ride](https://fee.org/articles/ticket-to-ride): Analysis of free bus fare proposals in San Antonio and public transit policy
- [Baseball, Rule of Law, and the 'Torpedo Bat'](https://fee.org/articles/baseball-rule-of-law-and-the-torpedo-bat): Baseball as metaphor for rule of law and innovation in Venezuela vs US
- [Generation Gap: Iberia Unplugged](https://fee.org/articles/generation-gap-iberia-unplugged): Spain-Portugal power outage analysis and energy infrastructure failure
